_comment: docs/13 rule (2026-10-06): every published package has ONE build number on all six subdirs. `release` = the number every subdir must carry; `hotfixes` = declared per-subdir rebuilds between releases (also listed in docs/14); `next_release` = the numbers the next release (zig 0.17 wave or upstream-zig switch) will use. `retain` = release builds a published consumer (r-zig-toolchain) pins by exact build number; prune-universe.py never deletes them, even after a newer release (consumer contract, docs/14; r-zig-pixi 2026-10-07).
